metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a call, a five-pound answer, and a half-sheet that prefers whom.

yesterday: Yesterday's boxes were the best since Whitsun. Saturday will be seventeen shillings, or near it.
Pay the five pound. Five shillings a week, out of the stock, to hold five men through August. It is agreed.
A king at Michaelmas, cut to the Master's measure. The thirty-first of April was the date you gave him for the other play.
The hay is in. The barley is short. A feather, a ballad, and a whom. Tomorrow is yours at the lodging.
